meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以通过命令行工具控制浏览器,自动打开网页、读取页面内容、点击按钮、填写表单、截图并提取数据,然后把结果汇报给你。
howto.when: 当任务需要浏览网页、填写表单或提取网页数据时,即使你没明说要开浏览器,只要它有用就会触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,把页面标题和主要内容总结给我
say.note: 浏览器会打开该网址并读取内容

say.text: 在搜索框输入'天气'并点击搜索,然后截图
say.note: 会执行搜索并保存截图

say.text: 提取这个页面上所有商品名称和链接
say.note: 会抓取页面中的商品数据

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser via a command-line tool to open pages, read content, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract data, then report the results.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever a browser is useful — e.g., browsing pages, filling forms, or extracting web data — even if not explicitly requested.

say_en.text: Open example.com and summarize the page title and main content.
say_en.note: The browser opens the URL and reads the content.

say_en.text: Type 'weather' in the search box, click search, and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Performs the search and saves a screenshot.

say_en.text: Extract all product names and links from this page.
say_en.note: Scrapes product data from the page.
